summary: Staging was experiencing errors (500s) because the worker could not reach the queue. Sam resolved the issue by rotating broker credentials and providing a new staging AMQP URL. This allowed the workers to drain the backlog. A subsequent request was made for this URL so another developer could set up a second worker box.
decisions_made: Broker credentials were rotated and a new staging AMQP URL was provided to fix the staging issue.
Workers were pointed to the new URL and restarted, successfully draining the backlog.
open_question: The request for the staging queue URL for setting up a second worker box remains pending.
